title_en: Two or three citizens loved me

lines.en: Two or three citizens loved me,

lines.cyr: мене мама за граѓани не дава.
lines.lat: mene mama za graǵani ne dava.
lines.en: but my mother didn't give me to citizens.
Two or three villagers loved me,

lines.cyr: мене мама за селанин ме даде.
lines.lat: mene mama za selanin me dade.
lines.en: my mother gаve me to а villager.
On Sunday, they organized my wedding,
on Monday, I put my sickle on my shoulder.

lines.cyr: В' понеделник зедов српот на рамо,
lines.lat: V' ponedelnik zedov srpot na ramo,
lines.en: On Monday, I put my sickle on my shoulder,

lines.cyr: ме пратија право в' поле на жетва.
lines.lat: me pratija pravo v' pole na žetva.
lines.en: they sent me right away to harvest the field.
